about: The alignment operators of the lowest-redshift triplet's Map3 row at R = 14 arcmin, resolved by galaxy placement and divided by the gravity-only (GGG) term, at the TATT point of EXAMPLE_EVALUATE2.yaml.  Signed values; the plot script draws |value| with open markers for negative entries.  Written by the export cell of aperture_mass_statistic.ipynb, Section 7, from nw.map3_components().
